---
title: "Cross-section Simulation"
sidebar: simulation
---

Use a uniform two-dimensional cross-section when you need per-unit-length
line parameters or a local straight-edge field model. Finite launchers,
bends, and device corners need their own three-dimensional interpretation.

## AEDT Q2D

The [finite-ground CPW Q2D tutorial](../../notebooks/SCGSimExamples/CrossSectionSimulation/CpwFiniteGround/aedt_q2d.ipynb) · <a href="../../notebooks/SCGSimExamples/CrossSectionSimulation/CpwFiniteGround/aedt_q2d.ipynb" data-noresolveinput download>IPYNB</a> · <a href="../../notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/CrossSectionSimulation/CpwFiniteGround/aedt_q2d.qmd" data-noresolveinput download>QMD</a>
authors native rectangles, groups the Signal and reference Ground conductors,
and requests per-unit-length matrices. Use its AEDT and SCGSim prerequisites;
no GDS import or three-dimensional port sheet is needed for this model.

Preserve section axes, conductor thickness, material properties, reference
grouping, and Region padding. Read returned matrices with frequency, units,
conductor order, and adaptive history. State the matrix reduction when deriving
impedance or propagation quantities.

### Local interface fields

The [SimplePad local-interface Q2D tutorial](../../notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/SurfaceBands/SimplePad/aedt_q2d_interfaces.qmd)
defines explicit MA/MS/SA regions and field-integral unions. Download its
<a href="../../notebooks/SCGSimExamples/SurfaceBands/SimplePad/aedt_q2d_interfaces.ipynb" data-noresolveinput download>IPYNB</a>
and <a href="../../notebooks/src/SCGSimExamples/SurfaceBands/SimplePad/simplepad_interface_model.json" download>shared model JSON</a>
together.

Its finite truncation and straight-edge model are explicit assumptions;
use [Participation & Surface Loss](epr-loss.qmd) when applying the returned factors.
